Both openness conditions force weakly increasing minima/maxima and forbid mixing empty/nonempty rows; for nonempty rows all interior membership choices are independent and contribute 2^max(b−a−1,0). Interval-row pairs biject to two-row SSYT via (a_i+1,b_i+2), yielding hook-content formula. A finite weighted multichain rational generating function has unique largest weight 2^{m−2} at (0,m−1), giving the exact C_m residue and 4^(−r) fraction; lower poles have at most half that weight. Independent exhaustive semantic check of 74,954 relations for all 1≤r,m≤4 gives 3958 qualifying and 960 interval-valued or empty; diagonal count 2,7,80,2855,374660. Finite checks corroborate, infinite theorem follows analytically.
